description: Run your own screen over the live market: every pump.fun launch from our real-time stream plus DEX pools on Solana and Base, 120+ fields in 5m-24h windows, 8 presets. Use it to FIND tokens; then token_check to vet one, memecoin_holder_trace to trace its buyers, memecoin_watch to be alerted. Poll with `since`. Data refreshes every 20 s. Price $0.02. Paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana) per call; failed or empty calls are never charged.

inputSchema.description: A screen strategy. Each filter is {field: condition}. condition = {"min": x, "max": y} for numbers, true/false for booleans, {"in": [...]} / {"notIn": [...]} for strings, {"contains": text} for lists, {"exists": true}. Field names come from catalog_read what=screen_fields, e.g. ageMinutes, marketCapUsd, buyers.m5, buyRatio.m15, volumeUsd.h1, priceChangePct.m5, holders, top10HolderPct, devSoldPct, snipers, bundleSupplyPct, curveProgressPct, liquidityUsd, rugcheck.score, trace.coordinationRiskPct, learned.p2x6h.

filters.description: {field: condition}; added to the preset's filters (yours win).

since.description: Cursor from a previous response: only tokens created after it (for polling).

sources.description: pump.fun = bonding curves from our real-time stream; dex = DEX pools. Default both.

name: memecoin_screen
title: Memecoin screener (pump.fun live + DEX pools)
